Lessons.Title: Paper Clip Games (optional)
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: Create and play a number-line fraction game.
Key idea: Fraction benchmarks mark positions along an evenly partitioned number line; game rules should make outcomes comparable and fair.
How to reason: Locate the interval 0 to 2, subdivide equal whole units and justify a mark between benchmark numbers.
Source-inspired opening: Warm-up: Notice and Wonder: Lots of Paper Clips (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 2: A New Game with New Rules (15 minutes): apply the learning goal to the original contexts or representations. First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 3: Field Test (15 minutes): apply the learning goal to the original contexts or representations. First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.
Edulytics worked model: A clip lands at 5/4 on a 0-to-2 board. Is it to the right of 1?. Explain every transformation and check using equal wholes/units.
